python.policy: All workbench Python execution uses uv with the committed lockfile.

gmx.source: per-component micromamba prefix or an explicitly selected system/container installation

obabel.source: per-component micromamba prefix or system installation

pymol.source: per-component micromamba prefix or manual installation

gromacs_gpu.release_policy: Acceptance receipts must record the resolved immutable image digest; a mutable tag alone is not release-grade evidence.

boundaries: The workbench never downloads proprietary or license-restricted scientific tools automatically.
A missing tool is a failed capability check, not permission to silently change scientific parameters or backend.
